title: BasicProfile
description: Self.ID basic profile record schema — the primary identity record stored on Ceramic for a DID. Contains human-readable identity information such as name, bio, and avatar.

name.description: The display name of the DID subject

description.description: A short biography or description of the DID subject

emoji.description: An optional emoji to represent this profile

birthDate.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

residenceCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of residence

nationalities.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes representing nationalities

affiliations.description: List of organizational or community affiliations

ImageSources.title: ImageSources
ImageSources.description: A set of image alternatives at different sizes/formats

alternatives.description: Alternative sizes or formats of the image

ImageMetadata.title: ImageMetadata
ImageMetadata.description: Metadata for a single image resource stored on IPFS

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g. image/jpeg)

width.description: Width of the image in pixels

height.description: Height of the image in pixels
